profile.name: Thi Ha Zaw (zerozet22k)
profile.title: Software Engineer — Full-Stack, Backend & Systems
profile.about: Software engineer with professional web development experience since 2019. I build full-stack products, backend services, realtime applications, business systems, and integrations from architecture through deployment. My work spans TypeScript and Node.js systems, databases, Redis and background queues, realtime communication, external APIs, authentication and permissions, as well as C++ and game/simulation engineering. I am comfortable entering existing codebases, debugging difficult problems, improving architecture and performance, and building new systems from scratch.

projects.title: Elqen Zero
